title: CAST Agent Status Block
description: Machine-readable schema for the structured Status block emitted by every CAST agent at the end of task execution. Enables reliable orchestration, dashboard consumption, and changelog generation.

status.description: Terminal status of the agent's task execution.

summary.description: One-line description of what the agent did or why it is blocked/needs context.

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this status block (e.g. 'code-writer', 'debugger').

concerns.description: List of concerns when status is DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. Required when status is DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. May be empty for other statuses.

files_changed.description: Absolute paths of files created or modified during the task.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up actions for the orchestrator or user.

blockers.description: Descriptions of blocking issues. Required when status is BLOCKED.

context_needed.description: Descriptions of missing context. Required when status is NEEDS_CONTEXT.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Pin to '1.0' for all current agents.
